maddeler.e:
نتموضع (form IIq)
# نَتَمَوْضَعُ (natamawḍaʕu) /na.ta.maw.dˤa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
# نَتَمَوْضَعَ (natamawḍaʕa) /na.ta.maw.dˤa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
# نَتَمَوْضَعْ (natamawḍaʕ) /na.ta.maw.dˤaʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَوْضَعَ (tamawḍaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
